fusions.name: Spawning Tide
fusions.desc: Releases a cloud of spawn that deals 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves each [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on each one spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Overgrown
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 16 damage, uses up every affliction you have on the target with 50% more damage for each one used, and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Fringing Reef
fusions.desc: Raises a reef 5 tiles long for 6 seconds that nothing crosses, and restores 8 health to you.

fusions.name: A Grain a Year
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 12, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
